{"problem": "Perform dimensional analysis for Rayleigh-Bénard convection in a planar horizontal layer of fluid heated from below, to derive the dimensionless form of the Nusselt number (denoted as Nu). \nThis analysis uses ONLY the following 7 physical quantities as input parameters: \nthe height of the container (h), the thermal conductivity (lambda), the temperature difference between the top and bottom surfaces (delta_T), the gravitational acceleration (g), the coefficient alpha that measures the fractional decrease in fluid density per increase in temperature at constant pressure, the kinematic viscosity (nu), and the thermal diffusivity (kappa).", "csv_columns_by_index": {"0": "h", "1": "delta_T", "2": "lambda", "3": "g", "4": "alpha", "5": "nu", "6": "kappa", "7": "source", "8": "Ra", "9": "Nu"}}
